description: Read the full body and metadata for one Pathrule memory. Use this after pathrule_get_context, pathrule_goto, or pathrule_list_memories returns a memory_id. This reads cloud data only and does not inspect the user's local filesystem.

memory_id.description: Memory UUID returned by pathrule_get_context, pathrule_goto, or pathrule_list_memories.

name: pathrule_read_memory

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

node_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the node this memory hangs on.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

source.description: How the memory was authored, for example claude or manual.

version_id.description: Optimistic-concurrency token. Pass it as expected_version_id to pathrule_update_memory.

title: Read Memory
